name: Compliance Monetisation & Ledger Gate Loop
description: A self-reinforcing monetisation loop that intercepts free-tier operators at the moment of maximum intent — anchoring a BUSINESS_RESERVATION — and presents a frictionless per-event M-Pesa escrow path (2.5% of agreed fare via STK push) as an immediate unblocking mechanism, while simultaneously surfacing quantified KES revenue-exposure figures to drive subscription conversion. The loop operates through six gate states: free-tier operators who hit the 5/month quota cap are shown their exact unverified revenue exposure and offered either a per-event escrow payment or a subscription upgrade. Completed per-event escrow payments anchor the reservation and accumulate monthly fee totals; when those totals exceed the Starter subscription cost (KES 1,200), an inline conversion prompt fires with operator-specific ROI copy. Every state transition emits a PostHog event, and the M-Pesa callback handler closes the loop by calling anchorBusinessReservation only after STK push ResultCode === 0, ensuring escrow reliability drives ledger integrity.
linked_feature: M-Pesa Payment Store & STK Push Flow

functions.name: getLedgerGateStatus
functions.signature: getLedgerGateStatus(orgId: string, bookingId: string, context: { agreedFare: number; mpesaAccountLinked: boolean }) => Promise<LedgerGateStatus>
functions.logic: Accepts orgId, bookingId, and a context object containing agreedFare and mpesaAccountLinked boolean. First attempts to read a cached LedgerGateStatus from Redis using key pattern 'ledger_gate:{orgId}:{currentMonthISO}'. On cache hit, returns the parsed status immediately. On cache miss, queries the database via the ledger_anchor_usage view to get the org's anchor count for the current calendar month and retrieves the org's subscription tier to determine the monthly cap (free tier cap is 5). If anchorCount < cap, returns { status: 'ALLOWED', anchorCount, cap } and caches for 60 seconds. If anchorCount >= cap, checks context: if agreedFare > 0 AND mpesaAccountLinked is true, returns { status: 'PER_EVENT_OFFER', escrowAmountKes: agreedFare * 0.025, anchorCount, cap } and caches for 30 seconds. Otherwise returns { status: 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED', anchorCount, cap } and caches for 30 seconds. On any database error, logs the error and returns { status: 'ALLOWED' } as a fail-open fallback to avoid blocking legitimate operators.

functions.name: assertLedgerNotGated
functions.signature: assertLedgerNotGated(orgId: string, bookingId: string, context: { agreedFare: number; mpesaAccountLinked: boolean }) => Promise<LedgerGateStatus>
functions.logic: Calls getLedgerGateStatus with the provided arguments. If the returned status is 'ALLOWED', returns the status object so the caller can proceed. If the status is 'PER_EVENT_OFFER', throws a typed LedgerGateError with code 'PER_EVENT_OFFER' and attaches the full gate status (including escrowAmountKes) to the error payload so the API endpoint can return it to the client for UI rendering. If the status is 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED', throws a typed LedgerGateError with code 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED'. The thrown error must be an instance of a named class (e.g., LedgerGateError extends Error) so catch blocks can use instanceof checks. Include the orgId and bookingId in the error payload for logging context.

functions.name: initiatePerEventEscrow
functions.signature: initiatePerEventEscrow(params: { orgId: string; bookingId: string; agreedFare: number; operatorPhone: string; userId: string }) => Promise<{ checkoutRequestId: string; escrowAmountKes: number }>
functions.logic: Computes escrowAmountKes as Math.ceil(params.agreedFare * 0.025) to round up to the nearest KES integer. Calls the M-Pesa STK push provider (mpesa-provider.ts) with the operator's phone number, escrowAmountKes, a description string 'Ledger anchor escrow for booking {bookingId}', and the account reference set to bookingId. On successful STK push initiation (receiving a CheckoutRequestID from Daraja), stores a Redis hash at key 'per_event_intent:{CheckoutRequestID}' with fields: orgId, bookingId, agreedFare, escrowAmountKes, userId, initiatedAt (ISO timestamp), status: 'PENDING'. Sets Redis TTL to 600 seconds (10 minutes) to handle STK push timeout. Inserts a row into per_event_escrow_records with status 'PENDING', checkout_request_id, org_id, booking_id, agreed_fare, escrow_amount_kes, and created_at. Returns { checkoutRequestId, escrowAmountKes }. If the STK push call fails, throws an error with code 'STK_PUSH_FAILED' without inserting the database record. If the Redis write fails after a successful STK push, logs a critical error and still returns the checkoutRequestId so the callback can attempt a database-only lookup as fallback.

functions.name: resolvePerEventEscrow
functions.signature: resolvePerEventEscrow(checkoutRequestId: string, mpesaReceiptNumber: string) => Promise<{ bookingId: string; orgId: string; escrowAmountKes: number }>
functions.logic: Reads the Redis hash at 'per_event_intent:{checkoutRequestId}'. If the key does not exist (TTL expired or Redis miss), falls back to querying per_event_escrow_records by checkout_request_id to reconstruct the context. Validates that the record status is 'PENDING'; if already 'COMPLETED' or 'FAILED', throws an idempotency error to prevent double-anchoring. Updates the per_event_escrow_records row: sets status to 'COMPLETED', mpesa_receipt_number to mpesaReceiptNumber, completed_at to now(). Deletes the Redis intent key to free memory. Returns { bookingId, orgId, escrowAmountKes } so the callback handler can call anchorBusinessReservation with the correct context. Does not call anchorBusinessReservation itself — that is the callback handler's responsibility to maintain single-responsibility separation.

functions.name: POST
functions.logic: Extracts bookingId from event.params.id and parses the request body for { path: 'SUBSCRIPTION' | 'PER_EVENT', agreedFare?: number }. Loads the session and org context from event.locals. Calls assertLedgerNotGated(orgId, bookingId, { agreedFare: body.agreedFare ?? 0, mpesaAccountLinked: locals.mpesaAccountLinked }). If assertLedgerNotGated throws a LedgerGateError with code 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED', returns a 402 JSON response with { gateStatus: 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED', unverifiedRevenueExposureKes: locals.vtSnapshot?.unverified_revenue_exposure_kes }. If it throws 'PER_EVENT_OFFER', returns a 402 JSON response with the full gate status including escrowAmountKes. If assertLedgerNotGated resolves (ALLOWED), branches on body.path: for 'SUBSCRIPTION', calls anchorBusinessReservation(bookingId, orgId) directly and returns 200 with { anchored: true, path: 'SUBSCRIPTION' }. For 'PER_EVENT', calls initiatePerEventEscrow with operator phone from locals and returns 200 with { path: 'PER_EVENT', checkoutRequestId, escrowAmountKes, message: 'STK push sent' }. Wraps the entire handler in try/catch; on unexpected errors returns 500. Measures and logs handler duration for p95 latency monitoring.

functions.name: POST
functions.logic: Parses the Daraja callback body from event.request.json(). Extracts Body.stkCallback.ResultCode, Body.stkCallback.CheckoutRequestID, and Body.stkCallback.CallbackMetadata.Item array to find the MpesaReceiptNumber. If ResultCode !== 0, reads the Redis intent to get bookingId and orgId, updates per_event_escrow_records status to 'FAILED' with the ResultDesc, emits a PostHog server-side event 'per_event_escrow_failed' with { checkoutRequestId, resultCode, orgId }, and returns 200 (Daraja requires 200 even on business failures). If ResultCode === 0, calls resolvePerEventEscrow(checkoutRequestId, mpesaReceiptNumber) to get { bookingId, orgId, escrowAmountKes }. Then calls anchorBusinessReservation(bookingId, orgId). On anchorBusinessReservation success, updates the fleet_booking record: sets anchored_at to now(), anchor_path to 'PER_EVENT', anchor_escrow_amount_kes to escrowAmountKes. Emits PostHog server-side event 'per_event_escrow_completed' with { bookingId, orgId, escrowAmountKes, mpesaReceiptNumber }. Returns 200. If anchorBusinessReservation throws, logs the error, sets per_event_escrow_records status to 'ANCHOR_FAILED', emits 'per_event_anchor_failed' PostHog event, and returns 200 to prevent Daraja retry storms. All steps are wrapped in try/catch with structured error logging.

functions.name: deriveInitialState
functions.logic: Pure mapping function that takes a gateStatus object (or null for unevaluated state) and returns the corresponding AnchorButtonState string. Maps: null or undefined → 'IDLE'; gateStatus.status === 'ALLOWED' → 'IDLE'; gateStatus.status === 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED' → 'QUOTA_EXCEEDED'; gateStatus.status === 'PER_EVENT_OFFER' → 'PER_EVENT_OFFER'. Returns 'IDLE' as the safe default for any unrecognised status value. This function is called once on component mount using the gateStatus prop passed from the parent page, which has already fetched gate status server-side. The returned state is stored in a Svelte writable store or reactive variable that drives the component's conditional rendering blocks.

This is the single most meaningful signal for the growth loop: it confirms the entire escrow-to-anchor pipeline worked end-to-end, measures the per_event_escrow_first_completed conversion rate, and accumulates the monthly fee total used to trigger subscription conversion prompts.
